releases.name: Dungeon Cooking
releases.summary: Dungeon Cooking is a dark fantasy cooking roguelike about feeding a plague-struck town. Send heroes into the dungeon for ingredients, cook what they bring back, test ingredients on rats, heroes, or citizens, and keep the kitchen alive as the town slowly falls apart.

releases.name: Sokobomb
releases.summary: Sokobomb is a puzzle game about blowing things up to find your way forward.

releases.name: Voxel Breakers
releases.summary: Voxel Breakers is a short idle game where you break voxels, spend those broken voxels on Voxel Breakers, and let your Voxel Breakers break even more voxels for you.

releases.name: Lost Sock Simulator 3000
releases.summary:
Lost Sock Simulator 3000 is the groundbreaking idle clicker that finally answers humanity's oldest question by leaning fully into the chaos. 

Click to collect socks. Buy increasingly unhinged sock-production operations. Watch your empire of missing hosiery grow from a single lonely tube sock into an incomprehensible mountain of footwear that defies the laws of physics, economics, and good taste.

Start with nothing but determination and a suspicious washing machine. Reinvest your socks into bigger, weirder sock-generating machinery. Ascend through levels of sock-fueled madness as your production per second climbs from "found one hidden in the washing machine" to ludicrous numbers.

releases.name: Flame, Forest & Flood
releases.summary: A cozy three-player strategy showdown where simple rules meet surprising depth. Easy to learn, endlessly re-playable, and built so everyone can play, and anyone can win.

releases.name: Chigusa's Diary
releases.summary: Chigusa was just an everyday schoolgirl, but once she began to notice the boys, her life gradually started to change in unexpected ways...

releases.name: The Hero is too Powerful so let's Pleeeease Settle this Peacefully!
Faroda
releases.summary:
Faroda is a challenging 2D platformer with colorful pixel-art graphics and chiptune soundtrack.

Travel across the 5 islands of a remote archipelago, completing over 100 levels, collecting treasure chests and many hidden gems along the way.

Will you be able to help Faroda, the protagonist of this adventure, gather the immense wealth scattered across these islands?

And most importantly: will you be able to find the legendary artifact?

releases.name: Black Border 3
releases.summary:
Step into the inspection booth in Black Border 3, a thrilling dystopian border simulation game. Review complex documents, interrogate suspicious travelers, and uncover clever smuggling plots.

Earning your keep is crucial to surviving your 50-night assignment. Spend your hard-earned credits at the Supply Shop on tactical consumables, scanners, and speed boosts. 

Your shift is filled with difficult moral choices, unique characters, and even famous historical figures. Approve or reject them carefully, as your decisions lead to multiple branching endings seamlessly recorded in your Memory Bank. A single mistake could trigger a diplomatic incident, so choose wisely.

releases.name: The Final Days of Olin Earl
Work From Dungeon
releases.summary: A tiny adventure moves into the corner of your desktop. Click the mage and her monsters fight and grow stronger while you work. Collect and breed 99 monsters, climb toward the last foe waiting at the very end — an idle RPG you never have to stop for.

releases.name: Light the Void
releases.summary: Light the Void is a pixel-art incremental exploration game. Reveal a mysterious world one tile at a time, gather resources, restore ancient structures, and unlock powerful upgrades. Grow your void world, overcome colossal titans, and bring light.

releases.name: SILO 7
releases.summary: Dig through a collapsing nuclear silo, collect fuel cells and escape before the countdown hits zero. Falling monitors turn every tunnel into a trap. Plan your route, step aside at the right moment and race for three stars in this arcade puzzle game.

releases.name: Mind the Tilt
releases.summary: Your house is balanced on a pin, and everything in it has weight. Do the jobs, keep it level, and don't be the one the game names for tipping it. A physics party game for 1 to 8 players, on one PC or online, across 29 houses that each tip in their own way.

releases.name: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed
releases.summary: Test your memory by watching and listening to the sequence of lights and tones and repeating them if you can.  It starts off easy but quickly becomes challenging!  Challenge your friends on the Game Center and share your skills on Twitter and Facebook.*Brain Cubes is not endorsed by or affiliated with Milton Bradley's Simon game.

releases.name: DELIVERX
releases.summary: An online game for four players in which you and your friends will need to deliver packages and escape from monsters. Deliver packages, level up, and try to deliver everything.

releases.name: Sardoinky
releases.summary: Sardoinky is an oddly satisfying case-opening clicker. Rip open sardine tins, flip the fish inside, and cash in. Build a crew of oddballs to keep the cans coming, unlock auto-openers and powerful upgrades, and chase that one legendary pull. Strangely addictive.

releases.name: Fantasy Camp Builder
releases.summary: A cozy campsite building game where you create medieval-fantasy campsites with charming decorations, warm lighting, and a relaxing atmosphere.

releases.name: LifeStock
releases.summary: FREE FOR THE DAY - Bugs everywhere! Crush the Bugs! The bugs rushed and ruined crops and homes. Use your powerful weapons and wisdom to destroy the bugs! It is your turn to exterminate those pesky critters to stop the infestation. * You pick your exterminating Ammo * 20 Challenging Levels with Crops and Homes to Protect How to Play: 1. Tap to start the Catapult 2. Tap again when you think the weapon should be launched from the Catapult Let the extermination start now!!

releases.name: Pokart
releases.summary: Play with friends in this poker-based kart racer- Get the best hand and cross the finish line before you lose it!

releases.name: Tavern Clicker
releases.summary: Run a cozy medieval tavern in this simple clicker. Serve all kinds of guests, unlock new brews, automate your work, and turn a humble alehouse into a tavern worthy of kings!

releases.name: BlackOut!
releases.summary: How long can you brain survive the Black Out!

releases.name: As the Lady Chooses
releases.summary: Seek your perfect match in Regency London! A wealthy suitor would save your family from ruin—but what about your heart and your literary dreams? An interactive Regency romance novel, 259 words and hundreds of choices, without graphics or sound effects.
